_comment: Configurable qualification rule for leaderboard inclusion and baseline-era z-score eligibility. A single fixed attempt count (e.g. 100) is not meaningful across season lengths ranging from 9 to 17 games, so the default scales to each season's schedule length via config/season_calendar.json.

per_game_rate.description: NFL's own official passing-title qualification rule: 14 attempts per scheduled team game, rounded to the nearest whole attempt.

fixed.description: A flat attempt count regardless of season length. Provided as an alternative for sensitivity testing; not the default because it misrepresents short/strike seasons and pre-1978 schedules.
